description: This file defines a view class for listing OAuth2 authorization codes within the SuiteCRM application. It extends the base ViewList class and customizes the display by hiding mass update fields and the quick edit icon.

classes.name: OAuth2AuthCodesViewList
classes.description: A view class for listing OAuth2 authorization codes in the SuiteCRM application, with customized pre-display behavior.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Overrides the parent preDisplay method to hide mass update fields and the quick edit icon before rendering the list view.
